scripts.profile:cpu: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir profiles bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:heap: bun run build:native && mkdir -p profiles && bun --heap-prof-md --heap-prof-dir profiles bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.profile:native-memory: bun run build:native && MIMALLOC_SHOW_STATS=1 bun bench/profile-runtime.ts
scripts.lint: bun run tsc && bun run lint:biome && bun run lint:oxlint
scripts.fmt:native: find native bench test -type f -name '*.cpp' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -i
